import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static int N;
    static ModInt[][] probability = new ModInt[10][10];

    static class ModInt {
        int val;

        public ModInt(long v) {
            v %= MOD;
            if (v < 0) v += MOD;
            this.val = (int) v;
        }

        public static int modInv(int a, int m) {
            int g = m, r = a, x = 0, y = 1;
            while (r != 0) {
                int q = g / r;
                int tmp = g % r;
                g = r;
                r = tmp;
                int tmpX = x - q * y;
                x = y;
                y = tmpX;
            }
            return x < 0 ? x + m : x;
        }

        public ModInt add(ModInt other) {
            int res = this.val + other.val;
            if (res >= MOD) res -= MOD;
            return new ModInt(res);
        }

        public ModInt subtract(ModInt other) {
            int res = this.val - other.val;
            if (res < 0) res += MOD;
            return new ModInt(res);
        }

        public ModInt multiply(ModInt other) {
            long res = (long) this.val * other.val;
            res %= MOD;
            return new ModInt(res);
        }

        public ModInt divide(ModInt other) {
            return this.multiply(new ModInt(modInv(other.val, MOD)));
        }

        public ModInt pow(long p) {
            assert p >= 0;
            ModInt a = this;
            ModInt result = new ModInt(1);
            while (p > 0) {
                if ((p & 1) == 1) result = result.multiply(a);
                a = a.multiply(a);
                p >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }

        public int toInt() {
            return val;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        N = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            String[] parts = br.readLine().split(" ");
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                int p = Integer.parseInt(parts[j]);
                probability[i][j] = new ModInt(p).divide(new ModInt(100));
            }
        }

        List<List<Integer>> masksWithCount = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
            masksWithCount.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        int[] lookup = new int[1 << N];
        Arrays.fill(lookup, -1);

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); mask++) {
            int count = Integer.bitCount(mask);
            lookup[mask] = masksWithCount.get(count).size();
            masksWithCount.get(count).add(mask);
        }

        Map<Long, ModInt> possibleMasks = new HashMap<>();
        long firstMask = 1L << lookup[0];
        possibleMasks.put(firstMask, new ModInt(1));

        for (int left = 0; left < N; left++) {
            Map<Long, ModInt> newPossibleMasks = new HashMap<>();
            ModInt[] products = new ModInt[1 << N];
            Arrays.fill(products, new ModInt(1));

            for (int current = 0; current < (1 << N); current++) {
                ModInt prod = new ModInt(1);
                for (int right = 0; right < N; right++) {
                    if (((current >> right) & 1) == 1) {
                        prod = prod.multiply(probability[left][right]);
                    } else {
                        prod = prod.multiply(new ModInt(1).subtract(probability[left][right]));
                    }
                }
                products[current] = prod;
            }

            List<Long> keys = new ArrayList<>(possibleMasks.keySet());
            for (Long possible : keys) {
                ModInt prob = possibleMasks.get(possible);
                int[] newBits = new int[N];
                Arrays.fill(newBits, 0);
                for (int maskIdx = 0; maskIdx < masksWithCount.get(left).size(); maskIdx++) {
                    int maskVal = masksWithCount.get(left).get(maskIdx);
                    if (((possible >> lookup[maskVal]) & 1) == 1) {
                        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                            if (((maskVal >> i) & 1) == 0) {
                                int newMaskVal = maskVal | (1 << i);
                                newBits[i] |= 1L << lookup[newMaskVal];
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                long[] newPossible = new long[1 << N];
                Arrays.fill(newPossible, 0);
                for (int current = 1; current < (1 << N); current++) {
                    int ctz = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(current);
                    newPossible[current] = newPossible[current & (current - 1)] | newBits[ctz];
                    long key = newPossible[current];
                    ModInt val = prob.multiply(products[current]);
                    newPossibleMasks.put(key, newPossibleMasks.getOrDefault(key, new ModInt(0)).add(val));
                }
            }
            possibleMasks = newPossibleMasks;
            System.err.println(possibleMasks.size());
        }

        ModInt answer = new ModInt(0);
        for (Map.Entry<Long, ModInt> entry : possibleMasks.entrySet()) {
            long key = entry.getKey();
            ModInt val = entry.getValue();
            if (((key >> lookup[(1 << N) - 1]) & 1) == 1) {
                answer = answer.add(val);
            }
        }
        System.out.println(answer.toInt());
    }
}
